No infinite assertion is inferred solely from finite samples.

value.rationale: A well-motivated quantitative spectral convergence problem from penalized constrained Langevin sampling. The all-fixed-mode theorem supplies the common sqrt-penalty boundary-layer length and a strictly negative fourth-power mode-dependent departure at order \(n^{-3/2}\), not implied by invariant \(W_2\) convergence or a rough mixing bound. This is a complete natural benchmark rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
